claim.quote: These results set the most stringent direct-detection constraint to date on the WIMP-proton spin-dependent cross section at 2.5 $\times$ 10$^{-41}$ cm$^2$ for a 25 GeV WIMP, and improve on previous PICO results for 3-5 GeV WIMPs by an order of magnitude.

key_value.note: Spin-dependent WIMP-proton limit at 25 GeV; the abstract gives no confidence level.

name: Dark Matter Search Results from the Complete Exposure of the PICO-60 C$_3$F$_8$ Bubble Chamber

summary.plain: The final PICO-60 results: a new blind exposure at a lower energy threshold tightened the limit on dark matter coupling to the proton's spin, with a large gain for light WIMPs of 3-5 GeV.
summary.technical: 52 kg C3F8 at thresholds as low as 1.2 keV; new blind 1404 kg-day exposure at 2.45 keV (taken April-June 2017) with about the same expected background as the earlier 1167 kg-day exposure at 3.3 keV; new optical tracking analysis enlarges the fiducial volume; limit 2.5e-41 cm^2 for a 25 GeV WIMP (Phys. Rev. D 100, 022001).

title: Dark Matter Search Results from the Complete Exposure of the PICO-60 C$_3$F$_8$ Bubble Chamber
why_it_matters: The abstract states the limit is the most stringent direct-detection constraint to date on the WIMP-proton spin-dependent cross section and an order-of-magnitude improvement for 3-5 GeV WIMPs.
